issues.description: The problem statement requires the end of the main loop to be marked with the label 'loop_end', but the solution uses the label 'end_loop' and the template does not contain 'loop_end'. This naming mismatch can confuse students about the exact label they must add and may cause automated checks or graders expecting 'loop_end' to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the label name consistent. Either change the solution label 'end_loop' to 'loop_end', or update the problem statement to require 'end_loop' (and ensure the template shows/mentions the same label). Preferably rename the solution label to 'loop_end' to match the problem instructions.
